name: ChessMD
tagline: ChessMD is a Qt-based chess app to play, analysis, review chess game and browse chess opening database.
blurb: Improve your chess with unlimited game review, interactive engine analysis, and several other state-of-the-art training utilities.
description:
Improve your chess with unlimited game review, interactive engine analysis, and several other state-of-the-art training utilities.

• Play with bots - You can play with engine with different ELOs

• Game Review - The game review feature provides a detailed analysis of each move to help players understand the accuracies of their moves.

• Chess Engine Analysis - You can select a chess engine to analyze the game.

• Import chess.com games - You can import your chess.com games

• Opening Explorer - You can browse chess database move by move

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
